description: Hard local-model evaluation tasks for Armenian politics workflows. Each prompt is self-contained and source-pack grounded so deterministic checks can validate structure, caution, entity typing, and evidence discipline.

tasks.title: Separate a politician from the prime-minister office
tasks.prompt:
Разбери пакет источников и верни только JSON. Нужно отделить человека от должности и построить осторожные claims.

Источники:
S1: Official biography page says Nikol Pashinyan was elected Prime Minister of Armenia by the National Assembly on 2018-05-08.
S2: Government directory says the Prime Minister of Armenia is an office inside the Government of Armenia.
S3: A social post says: 'Pashinyan is the prime minister, therefore the person and the office are the same node.'

Задача: выведи сущности, claims и cautions. Не сливай PERSON и OFFICE.

tasks.title: Do not collapse party, faction, and office
tasks.prompt:
Верни только JSON. Разреши сущности и отношения без слияния разных типов.

Источники:
S1: Armenia's National Assembly lists Alen Simonyan as President of the National Assembly.
S2: Civil Contract is described as a political party associated with the parliamentary majority.
S3: A faction page uses the label Civil Contract faction for the parliamentary faction.
S4: A commentator writes: 'Civil Contract, the Civil Contract faction, and the National Assembly presidency are effectively the same political object.'

Задача: выдели PERSON, PARTY, FACTION, OFFICE и explain cautions.

forbidden_terms: одним и тем же политическим объектом

tasks.title: Compare conflicting official and watchdog claims
tasks.prompt:
Верни только JSON. Не выбирай победителя без достаточных доказательств.

Источники:
S1: A ministry statement says a public procurement reform is on schedule and implementation milestones are being met.
S2: A civil-society watchdog report says several milestones are delayed and asks for a revised timetable.
S3: A media article quotes both S1 and S2 but adds no independent documents.

Задача: сделай comparison claims, source_use, unresolved_questions и cautions.

tasks.title: Refuse an unsupported party-switch claim
tasks.prompt:
Верни только JSON. Нужно проверить, можно ли занести claim в граф.

Источники:
S1: Anonymous Telegram channel claims a named Armenian MP has secretly switched party allegiance.
S2: The MP's official parliamentary profile still lists the original faction.
S3: No party statement, parliamentary record, or direct quote is present in the packet.

Задача: реши, какой статус claim должен получить: verified, candidate, rejected, or insufficient_evidence. Укажи почему.

tasks.title: Resolve Armenian, Russian, and English aliases safely
tasks.prompt:
Верни только JSON. Разреши алиасы и типы.

Alias packet:
A1: Նիկոլ Փաշինյան
A2: Nikol Pashinyan
A3: Никола Пашинян
A4: ՀՀ վարչապետ
A5: Prime Minister of Armenia
A6: премьер-министр Армении

Задача: сгруппируй алиасы в канонические сущности, отдели PERSON от OFFICE, и предложи безопасные edges.

tasks.title: Handle an accusation with high-risk relation rules
tasks.prompt:
Верни только JSON. Это high-risk political relation.

Источники:
S1: An opposition speech accuses a minister of favoring a donor in a contract.
S2: Procurement records confirm a contract exists but do not mention favoritism.
S3: The minister denies wrongdoing.
S4: No court filing, audit finding, or official investigation document is in the packet.

Задача: не создавай canonical ACCUSED_OF/FAVORITISM fact unless threshold is met. Сформулируй candidate claims, evidence gaps, and cautions.

tasks.title: Represent office holders over time without overwriting history
tasks.prompt:
Верни только JSON. Обнови граф с temporal edges.

Источники:
S1: Person A held a ministry office from 2019-01-01 to 2021-08-02.
S2: Person B was appointed to the same office on 2021-08-02.
S3: A summary page currently says only 'Person B is the minister'.

Задача: предложи claims/edges так, чтобы не удалить историю Person A и не сделать two simultaneous holders without dates.

tasks.title: Produce a quote-disciplined political brief
tasks.prompt:
Верни только JSON. Напиши краткий политический brief без новых фактов.

Источники:
S1: Government statement: 'The draft electoral reform package will be submitted after interagency review.'
S2: Opposition statement: 'The process lacks transparency and should include public hearings before submission.'
S3: NGO note: 'Public consultation materials have not yet been published on the ministry website.'

Задача: brief должен отделять official plan, opposition criticism, and NGO observation. Используй source_ids for every claim.

tasks.title: Keep country graph as validated export, not scratchpad
tasks.prompt:
Верни только JSON. Определи, что можно писать в validated country graph, а что должно остаться в claims log.

Источники:
S1: Official page confirms a ministry exists.
S2: Media report claims a planned reshuffle may occur next month, citing unnamed sources.
S3: Analyst comment speculates that the reshuffle would strengthen one faction.

Задача: классифицируй каждую запись как validated_graph, claims_log, or reject. Объясни why.

tasks.title: Multi-hop reasoning across offices, parties, and evidence strength
tasks.prompt:
Верни только JSON. Сделай multi-hop answer without hallucinating.

Источники:
S1: Candidate X was nominated by Party Y for a municipal election.
S2: Party Y is part of Alliance Z for this election cycle.
S3: Candidate X previously served in Office Q until 2020-12-31.
S4: A blog says Candidate X still controls Office Q through allies but gives no documents.

Вопрос: какие verified links можно вывести между Candidate X, Party Y, Alliance Z, and Office Q? Что нельзя утверждать?
